notes: Optical atomic clock (not Rydberg RF sensor). Strontium or Ytterbium lattice clock technology. Package: 30L volume, 30kg weight, 3U rack mount chassis. Hydrogen maser frequency stability at 1 second, outperforms Cs beam clocks at 1 day holdover. 10,000x higher atomic transition frequency than microwave clocks. Ruggedization proven in PNTAX23 field trials, flight trials, shock/vibration testing. Pilot line production underway 2024. First commercial delivery: UK (2024). DARPA success story filed Feb 2026. SWaP: 30L/30kg is NOT a chip-scale clock - this is a precision timing system for fixed/semi-fixed infrastructure. Distinct from Infleqtion's Rydberg RF sensor work.
